meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Agar aapki skin **acne-prone / oily** hai, to ₹700 ke andar sabse safe aur practical pick usually **2% Salicylic Acid serum** hota hai, kyunki ye pores unclog karke active pimples aur blackheads par kaam karta hai.[5][9][12][16]

**Best overall pick:** **The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Face Serum** — ye **2% Salicylic Acid + 5% Niacinamide** ke saath aata hai aur acne-prone/oily skin ke liye listed hai; price around **₹499–₹526** dikh raha hai.[1][5][17]

**Agar marks/scars bhi zyada hain:** **Minimalist 5% Niacinamide Face Serum** ya **Minimalist 10% Niacinamide Face Serum** consider kar sakte ho; niacinamide acne marks, oil balance, aur skin barrier support ke liye useful hota hai, aur ye budget me mil raha hai.[2][9][15]

**Agar active acne + redness/irritation hai:** **Dot & Key Cica 2% Salicylic Acne Control Serum** ek decent option hai, jo Nykaa par around **₹339** aur Dot & Key par around **₹509** listed hai.[5][11]

**Simple recommendation by need:**
- **Active pimples/blackheads:** **The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide**.[1][5][17]
- **Oily skin + acne marks:** **Minimalist Niacinamide 5%/10%**.[2][9][15]
- **Sensitive acne-prone skin:** **Dot & Key Cica 2% Salicylic**.[3][5][11]

**Kaise use karein:** raat me 2–3 baar/hafta se start karo, moisturizer lagao, aur next morning **sunscreen** zaroor use karo; salicylic acid aur niacinamide dono acne-prone skin me common budget ingredients hain.[1][9][12]

Agar aap chaho, main **oily, sensitive, ya acne marks-focused** skin ke hisaab se **exact 1 serum** choose karke de deta hoon.
